tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// brtag gnyis nas gsungs pa rdo rje'i glu'i skad gnyis shan sbyar bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// kol+la i re ṭaṭhi a po la mu m+mu re ka k+ko la/ gha ṇa kri pi ṭa ho padz+dza i ka ru ṇe ki a i ṇa ro la/ ta hiṃ ba la khadz+dza i ga ḍheṃ ma a ṇa bidz+dza a i/ ha le ka liñdza ra pā ṇi a i dun dhu ra badz+dza a i/ tsa u sa ma kas+ṭhū ri sih+la// bde ba can gnas rdo rje ni// lte ba ru ni pad+ma yi// rgyun du 'bod la cang te'u brdung*// rtsod par mi bya snying rje bas// de la sha ni bza' ba dang*// chang ni shin tu btung ba ste// kye ho skal ldan gzhugs par bya// skal ba med pa spangs nas su// bshang ba dang ni gci ba rdul// kat+pū ra lā i a i/ ma la i in+dha ṇa swā li dza ta haṃ bha tu kha i a i/ brem+ṣakhe ṭa ka ran+te shud+dha a shud+dha ṇa ma ṇi a i/ ni raṃ shu aṅga tsa ḍa bi ta hiṃ dza shrā wa pā ṇi a i/ mā la a dze kun+tu ru pa ṭa i ḍin ḍi la ta hiṃ ṇa badz+dza a i/// / khu ba rnams ni sbyar bar bya// tshod ma dang ni sha chen po// de la mang po bza' ba yin// 'ong ba dang ni 'gro bar byed// dag dang ma dag mi dmigs pas// rus rgyan yan lag rnam la gdags// de ru ro ni gzhug par bya// 'dus par dbang gnyis sbyor 'jug pa// reg min de la spangs bya min// grub pa'i legs bshad ji bzhin du// blo gsal pad+ma dkar pos sgyur// brda don gsum gyi bshad pa mkha' 'gro'i gsang gtam zhes bya ba dgyes pa rdo rje'i man ngag// / ༈ gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa ni// thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs pa'i// rdo rje'i slob dpon tshogs kyi rje// dpal ldan nā ro ta par 'dud// nyi ma'i btung bas rab myos ma'i// pad+ma gzhibs pas mdar ba'i zhal// gsar ba'i bdud rtsi spro ba la// sprin gsar dag pa bzhin du dkar// 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi gzhung dang po rdo rje'i glu bshad par bya ste/ dpal rgyal ba'i dbang pos chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes khong du chud pa'i mthus lta ba ngan pa rnams zil gyis gnon cing rang gi rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pas na rdo rje'i glu ste/

rdo rje pha lam bzhin no zhes gsungs la/ 'di drang don du bshad pas dpa' bo'i rim pa'i brtul zhugs dang*/ nges don du bshad pas bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i brtul zhugs te/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs dang ni// rang byin brlab pa'i rim pas kyang*// kun rdzob don dam tshul can gyi// byang chub sems ni rab tu bskyed// kun rdzob kun+da lta bu nyid// don dam bde ba'i gzugs can no// zhes so// dang po ni/ ko bde ba/ l+la.i re/ gzung ba/ bde ba gzung ba nyid kyi phyir bde ba can te/ don chos 'byung gi gzhi'i gzhal yas khang de gang du 'tshog par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o// ṭaṭhi a/ gnas pa/ su dag gnas na/ bo la/ rdo rje/ thabs rnal 'byor pa dang*/ shes rab rnal 'byor ma rnams mnyam zhing mnyam pa rdo rje yin pas de dag go /ji ltar 'tshog pa/ mam+mu ni/ lte ba ru/ re ka k+ko la/ pad+ma yi/ rdo rje slob dpon yab yum lte ba dang*/ slob ma pho mo rnams pad+ma'i 'dab ma rnams la gral rim du bya bas so// der ji ltar bya na/ gha ṇa/ rgyun du/ kri pi ṭa/ cang te'u/ ho/ 'bod pa la/ badz+dza i/ brdung pa ste/ dang po brtsams nas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ma thob kyi bar du rgyun chags par bya dgos pas dang*/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor der mkha' 'gro ma thams cad gtor ma la sogs pas mchod pa'i phyir 'bod pa la cang te'ur krol bar bya ste/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong gis dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa'i mtshams bzhir lcags kyu bris la dbus su gnas nas/ lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal gyis mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi ming gi dang po de'i mthar/ khreṃ hūm̐ zhes 'gyings pa dang bcas pas dkrol na thams cad 'ong bar 'gyur te/ ma 'ongs na de dag 'chi bar 'gyur la/ gal te las ma grub na slob dpon khros pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rdung bar byed na mkha' 'gro ma rnams mchi ma 'dzag bzhin du khugs shing las byed par 'gyur ro// cang te'u de la'ang phyi nang gnyis las/

phyi ni rdo rje can gyi shing go shīr+ṣa dang*/ tsan dan dmar po sogs gang 'dod pa'i shing las byas pa/ nang skyes pa lo bcu drug pa'i dang*/ bud med lo bcu gnyis ma'i thod pa spyi bo sprad/ dga' ba bcu drug dag pa'i bu ga bcu drug ro skra gsum dril gyi skud pas drwa ba'i tshul du bcings pa/ rab sor bcu gnyis/ 'bring sor bcu gcig dang bcu pa/ tha ma sor dgu pa/ kha la de'i phyed/ spre'u'i pags pa la zla mtshan gyi pad 'dab lte ba dang bcas pa lhag pa'i lha tshogs sam/ sngags sam/ sa bon bkod nas rab tu gnas par byas pa des g.yog cing*/ chu skyar gyi rkang pa'i rus pas brdung bar bya'o/ de dag kyang saṃ phu ṭar/ de nas cang te'u'i mtshan nyid bshad// sogs kyis gsungs so// 'dis mtshon pa glu dang*/ gar dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ lta stangs khyad par du byed do// lta stangs kyis sems can gzhug pa la sogs pa'i 'phrin las bzhi la sbyor ba'ang bstan to// ka ru ṇe/ snying rje bas/ ki a i ṇa/ mi bya'o// gang mi bya na/ ro la/ 'thab mo/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du rnal 'byor pho mo rnams rtsod pa mi bya bar phan tshun snying rje bar gnas dgos so// ta hiṃ/ de la/ ba la/ sha khadz+dza i/ bza' bar bya/ gaḍhe/ 'di 'grel ba bcas chad 'dug ma a ṇa/ chang*/ bidz+dza a i/ btung bar bya ba ste/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor der sha ni rnam pa lnga ste/ gau la sogs pa'i sgras brjod pa/ saṃ phu ṭar/ bza' ba 'di dag yang dag brtsam// me tog bdug pa mar me dang*// de bzhin bza' ba bca' ba nyid// ces gsungs pa'o// chang ni/ mnyam sbyor las/ sgeg mo dang ni na chung dang*// myos dang de bzhin bdud rtsi dang*// gcig tu dpa' dang 'dod chags dang*// g.yo can de bzhin bran mo dang*// zhes gsungs pa'i don saṃ phu ṭar// chang ni sgeg mo ru ni brjod// ces sogs kyis bstan te/ don 'bru'i chang sgeg mo/ btsos pa'i chang rab tu myos ma na chung*/

bu ram gyi chang myos byed pa/ sbrang rtsi'i chang ni bdud rtsi ma/ rgun 'brum sbrang rtsi'i chang gcig tu bsres pa dpa' bo/ nya lcibs ni mnyam sbyor 'grel par tshwa ru bshad de/ chab tshwa'i gtung ba 'dod chags/ si ba bo zhes pa kāñdzi ka'i 'bru'i chang ngam/ skyur po'i khu ba la bshad cing*/ bshad pa'i sgras brjod pa g.yo can ma/ rtsabs dang sings pos ni myos byed rigs lhag ma gzhan thams cad de bran mo/ de ltar sangs rgyas kun gyi brdas/ bdud rtsi'i lam yan lag brgyad du bshad pa rnams so// shin tu de las gzhan pa'i bza' ba/ bca' ba/ bldag pa/ gzhib pa/ btung bar 'os pa'i rigs thams cad gzung bar gsungs pa ste/ saṃ phu ṭar/ de ltar bza' ba sna tshogs dang*// chang dang nya dang yang dag ldan// dga' ba'i longs spyod skal bzang bas// dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' bsgrub// ces pas so// ha le/ kye ho/ ka liñdza ra/ skal ldan/ pā ṇi a i/ gzhug bya zhing*/ kye ho zhes lhan cig spyod pa mo la bos nas/ rigs gang dang bya ba gang bsgrub pa de la skal ba dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ma de 'dod pa spyad pa'i ched du 'phang par gzhug par bya'o// dun dhu ra/ skal ba med pa/ badz+dza a i/ spangs nas su/ ma gsungs pa'i rig ma la bdud rtsi len pa bkag pas ma zhugs pa mi 'jug zhugs pa phyir dbyung ngo*// tsa u sa ma/ bshang ba/ kas+thu ri/ gci ba/ sital/ rang byung ngam rdul/ kut+pū ra sa/ khu ba/ lā i a i/ sbyar bar bya/ gzhan dag go /gzhi mnyam dang*/ gla rtsi dang*/ si la dang*/ ga bur rnams su bsgyur te/ sgra ji bzhin pa la de ka yin kyang 'di ni dgongs pa'i skad yin pas 'di ltar du rigs pa yin no// phyag rgya dang sbyar nas bdud rtsi bzhi 'dzag pa med par sbyar bar bya ba bstan la/ ma la i in+dha ṇa/ tshod ma dang ni/ sā li dza/ sha chen/ dpe kha gcig las sa li a/ ta hiṃ/ de la/ bha tu/ mang po/ kha e a e/ bza' ba yin/ don gtum mo'i mes bza' btung rnams tshod ma ste ra sā ya ṇa byas pa bzhin du sha chen lus kyi thig les mtshon nas/

gshang gci ngag khu khrag yid/ bzhi pa'i thig le rnams kyang 'pho ba med pas dwangs ma mi shigs pa'i thig ler mtshon pas/ phung po khams skyes mched mang po rnams 'ja' tshon tsam du de'i mtha' la bza' ba zhes pa'i don to// pre mā ṇa/ 'ong ba/ khe ṭa/ 'gro ba/ karan+te/ bya'o/ shud+dha/ dag pa/ a shud+dha/ ma dag pa/ ṇa ma ṇi a i/ mi dmigs pas/ byang sems dkar po steng du 'ong ba dang*/ dmar po 'og tu 'gro bar bya ste/ dag pa ye shes kyi rlung*/ ma dag pa las kyi rlung zhes gnyis su mi dmigs pa'i bzhon pa la zhon nas so// don srog thur ram/ nyi zla sgra gcan gyi khyim du 'dres pa'o// ni raṃ shu/ rus rgyan/ aṅga yan lag tsa ḍa bi/ gdags par bya/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs par bya bas te/ phyir rus pa'i rgyan gyis dang*/ nang byang sems kyi bgrod pa gnyis kyis so// ta hiṃ dza/ de ru/ shrā wa/ ro/ pā ṇi a i/ ni gzhug par bya/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor de ru ro mtshan nyid dang ldan pa drangs nas bsgrub pas mkha' la spyod pa'i rig 'dzin dang*/ gzhan yang des mtshon nas sa spyod/ sa 'og spyod kyi grub pa sogs thun mong ba'i dngos grub rab 'byams gang 'dod pa bsgrub par bya'o// mā la a dze/ 'dus par/ kun+tu ru/ dbang po gnyis sbyor/ ba ṭa i/ 'jug pa/ rtsi'i zhing du rlung la zhon nas thig le dkar dmar 'du ba der/ shes bya dang shes byed/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa/ nyi ma dang zla ba/ ā li kā li/ thabs dang shes rab kyi chas pho dbang mo dbang gi tha snyad bzhag tu rung ba thams cad mnyam par sbyar bas mngon par shes pa drug thob par 'gyur ro// ḍin ḍim/ reg min/ ta taṃ/ de la/ ṇa badz+dza a i/ spang bya min/ tshogs drug la ma zhen zhing*/ mi spong bar lam du khyer bas bde ba chen po'i longs spyod du bya'o// glu 'di len pa'i dus ni/ thun mtshams tshogs kyi dus/ dga' ston gzhan gnyis kyi skabs/ dbang bskur/ spyod pa'i dus so// len lugs/

ji skad bshad pa ni bzhi 'gyur yin la/ sh+lau ka re'i mthar rkang pa 'og ma gnyis sbyar ba ni drug ldan te/ don rim gyis pa'i gang zag mchog bar dman shin tu dman pa bzhi'i dang pos/ phyi rol gyi mkha' 'gro mnyes pas 'grub/ gnyis pas phyag rgya'i stobs las/ gsum pa de la goms par bsgoms pa'i stobs las/ bzhi pa ni ji skad bshad pa'i 'gros ji bzhin pas mngon shes sogs grub pa'i yon tan rnyed par bstan pas drug ldan dang bzhi ldan gnyis thob pa yin no// blangs pa'i dgos pa ni/ dam tshig bsrungs pa dang*/ 'di gnyis kyi ni tshogs bsrung zhing*// zhes pa'i don/ tshogs pa der bar chad med pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'o// de bzhin bdag kyang bsrung ba nyid/ bdag bar chad las bsrung ba dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'o// 'dis ni 'jig rten dbang du byed/ 'jig rten gsum dbang du sdud pa dang*/ 'dis ni sngags kyi bzlas pa nyid/ 'dis ni rlung sems dhū tīr gzhug pas bzlas pa ste/ don rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rnyed pas rnam par rtog pas bzhag pa'i lta ba thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'o// de tsam du ma zad/ gang du gus bcas glu len dang*// nas/ glu yi byin rlabs mtshan nyid do// zhes pa'i bar gyis tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor de byin gyis rlaubs pa'i rtags der sgog pa'i dri 'byung ste/ sha za las byed kyi mkha' 'gro 'dus nas byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ bya rgod kyi dris zhing skyong 'jig rten gyi ḍā ki mchog 'dus nas dang*/ ga pur gyi dris zhing skyong gi pho nya ye shes pa dang*/ mā la yar skyes te tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i dris lhan cig skyes ma 'dus nas byin gyis rlobs par byed pa shes so// sgra'i sgo nas/ 'jig rten pa rnams la ba la tshe'i sgra 'ong yang ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma rnams la ngang pa dang bung ba'i sgra chen po yang 'byung la/

des byin gyis rlobs par zhes shes nus so// gnyis pa ni bde ba can shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la btsun mo'i bha gar btags pa de'o// de ltar yang*/ bud med kak+ko la bde can// e waṃ rnam pa'i rang bzhin du// bde ba bsrung ba nyid kyi phyir// bde ba can zhes rab tu bsgrags// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi gnas// zhes so// gnas rdo rje ni/ de la gnas pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje/ ngo bo'i sgo nas don dam sems bskyed/ rnam pa'i sgo nas kun rdzob sems bskyed du 'jog pa de'o// de ltar yang*/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste// nas/ kun rdzob don dam tshul can no// zhes pa'i bar gyis so// lte ba ru ni/ de 'khor lo drug gi lte bar dang po'i dbyangs yig stong chen yi ge lnga'i rnam par shes pa'am/ blo zhes btags pa'i thig le drug tu gnas pas te/ ga pur nyid ni bdag med ma// bde ba bdag med tshul can nyid// de yi bde ba phyag rgya che// lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gnas// dang po'i dbyangs yig rang bzhin te// blo zhes sangs rgyas rnams kyis btags// zhes so// pad+ma yi/ pad+ma'i 'khyud pas bskul ba de// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor las// de nyid bcom ldan shes rab ma// de ni ring min thung ba min// gru bzhi ma yin zlum po min// dri dang ro dang mya ngan 'das// lhan cig skyes dga' byed pa can// zhes so// ji ltar bskul ba'i tshul ni// rgyun du/ rgyun chags par/ 'bod la cang te'u/ 'dir rdo rje me la srog zhugs pas rgyas pa de/ don rtsa dbu mar dag pa der dgug pa'i ched du/ brdung*/ srog thur gong bu gcig pa'am nyi zla mnyam pa nyid du sgra gcan gyis bzung ba nges so// rtsod par mi bya/ 'di ni 'bar ba/ 'di ni 'dzag pa/ 'di ni 'bar 'dzag 'thab pa'i dus zhes/ nges pa med pas so// snying rje las/

gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su snyoms par zhugs shing las kyi rlung gis bskul ba'i zhu ba'i thig le yang dang yang du 'khor lo drug tu mas rim gyis brtan par byed pa ste/ rnal 'byor ma lus dbus gnas su// nas/ bde ba zhes bya sku ru brjod// ces pa'i bar gyis so// de la sha ni bza' ba dang*/ bde ba bskyed pa des phung sogs lnga sgrib bral du bza' ba ste/ de las skyes la rnal 'byor de// de yi bde ba bza' ba nyid// ces so// chang ni shin tu btung ba ste// thig le bstan pa'i dga' ba'i chang*// so so rang rig pas 'thung zhing*/ so so rang rig gi chang de'ang mngon par byang chub pa mas brtan pa'i dga' bas 'thung ste/ deng ni chang yang btung bar bya// de nas rang yang btung ba nyid// ces so// kye ho zhes bod pa/ su bod na/ skal ldan/ 'tshang rgya nger/ rigs gang la shis pa'i phyag rgya la ni skal ldan yin la/ bzlog pa las dngos grub rnyed par mi 'gyur bas skal med do// de ltar yang*/ phyag rgya'i rtags dang mtshan ma dang*// 'dis ni rigs ni mtshon par bya// rigs 'tshel sgom pa'i sbyor ba las// dngos grub med cing sgrub po'ang med// ces nas/ 'dod pas phyag rgya shes par bya// zhes pa'i bar ro// phyag rgya'ang mtshan nyid/ shin tu bzhin bzang mig yangs ma// nas/ skra bzang sgrub pa po la dga'// zhes pa'i bar gyis bshad pa de'o// gzhug bya zhing*/ phyag rgya de la rjes su chags par bya'o zhes pa ste// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// phyi nas phyag rgya rjes chags bya// bo la kak+ko lar bcug nas// kun+tu ru byed brtul zhugs can// zhes so// skal ba med pa spangs nas su// byang chub kyi sems phyir lhung na mchog sgrub pa'i skal ba med pas phyir lhung du 'jug pa spang ste/ der ni sbyor ba las byung ba'i// nas/ mi 'chi lce yis blang ba nyid// ces so// dri med 'od du yang*/

lan cig rtag tu khu ba ltung ba'i phyir// gnyis ka la yang mchog gi bde ba med// ces pas so/ bshang ba rnam snang dang ni/ gci ba mi bskyod pa/ rdul rin 'byung*/ khu ba 'od dpag med rnams ni sbyar bar bya/ don yod grub pa de mngon par byang chub pa lngas dam pa rigs brgya rdzogs pa'i rdo rje'i skur ldang ngo*// de dang lhan cig phyag rgya che// bde ba sbyin pa'i dngos grub 'gyur// gzugs sgra de bzhin dri dang ni// ro dang de bzhin reg bya nyid// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin yang*// shes rab nyid kyis sbyang bar bya// de nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs// zhes so// tshod ma dang ni khams lnga rnam par rtog pa'i rlung*/ sha chen po/ mi rtog pa'i rlung*/ de la mang po bza' ba yin/ thams cad zad par byas nas gsung rdo rjer bzhed do// bde chen bzang po'i rnal 'byor ma// de nyid dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang*// ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can// zhes so// 'ong ba dang ni 'gro bar byed pa dkar cha steng gtsug tor du 'ong ba ste brtan pa dang*/ dmar cha rkang mthil du 'gro bar byed pa de gnon pa'o// dag dang*/ chos thams cad gnas pa ltar mthong bas gzigs pa dag pa dang*/ ma dag mi dmigs pas/ sangs ma rgyas pa'i chos ci'ang rnal 'byor pa de'i gzigs pa la med pas ma dag pa mi dmigs pa'o// rus rgyan yan lag rnams la gdags// rnal 'byor ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid du rdzogs pas te/ de nyid me long ye shes gzugs// mnyam nyid ye shes dngos po can// yang dag gyur pa so sor rtog /de nyid bya ba nan tan te// chos dbyings shin tu rnam dag pa// zhes so/ de ru ro ni gzhug par bya// byang chub kyi sems su rtsa rlung thig le bde ba'i 'gros thams cad bdag med pa'i rang bzhin gyis gzhug ste/ 'dus par dbang po gnyis sbyor 'jug pa/ gtsug tor mchog tu 'dus pa'am thim pa de'i tshe thabs shes kyi sbyor ba mthar thug nas mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das par 'jug pa ste/

de nyid dkyil 'khor bdag po nga*// de nyid bdag med rnal 'byor ma'i// zhes so// reg min/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs de bsam pas reg par mi nus pa ste/ chos kyi rang bzhin yin pas de// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can// zhes so// de la spang bya min/ bdag las gzhan no zhes logs su spang mi dgos te rang gi sems nyid dag pa de min pas so// lto ba gnas su brjod par bya// nas/ des ni bla med rnyed par 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan to// da ni zhar la ngag dang lus kyi brda bshad par bya ste/ ma da na/ chang*/ ba la/ sha mā la ya dza/ 'du ba/ khe ṭa/ 'gro ba/ shrā wa/ ro/ ni raṃ shu rus rgyan/ pre maṣa ṇa/ 'ong ba/ kri pi ṭa/ cang te'u/ dun dhu ra/ skal med/ ka liñdza ra/ skal ldan/ ḍin ḍi ma/ reg min/ pad+ma bhañdza na/ thod pa/ tri bi ta/ bza' ba/ ma la tin+dha na/ tshod ma/ tsā ru sa ma/ lci ba/ kas+thū ri/ gci ba/ sri h+la/ rang byung ngam rdul/ kat+pū ri/ khu ba/ sā li dza/ sha chen/ kun+tu ru/ dbang po gnyis sbyor/ bo la/ rdo rje/ kak+ko la pad+ma'o// lus kyi brda ni/ mdzub mo bsgreng ste ston na/ legs par 'ongs sam dri ba/ mdzub mo dang gung mo gshibs nas bsgreng ste ston pa lan te/ legs par 'ongs so zhes pa'o// g.yon pa'i mthe bong bcangs nas ston na/ sku khams bde 'am/ snyun gyi phyag rgya/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong bcangs nas ston pa bde'o// bum dbang ma thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa la mi srid pas/ de thob ma thob dri ma dgos/ sring lag dang mthe bong sbyar nas ston na/ de gnyis kyi thig le dkar dmar lce thog tu bzhag pa'i gsang dbang thob bam/ mgrin pa ston na/ mgrin par mid nas longs spyad pa'i gsang dbang thob bo// srin lag bsgrengs nas ston na/ dbang gsum thob bam/ khu tshur bcangs pa'i mthe'u chung bsgrengs nas ston na/ gsum pa thob pa a cang bzhi pa'ang thob bo// khu tshur bcangs nas gung mo bsgrengs te ston na/

zag pa med pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ngam/ khu tshur bcangs nas mdzub mo brkyang bskum yang yang bya nas ston pa/ zag med kyi bde ba myong zhing rnam par rtog pa las grol lo// mgo'i gos thod ston na/ bde ba chen po mtshon pa'i rtsa gang na gnas sam/ rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan te sor mo gsum bsgrengs nas ston na/ dhū tī ro brkyang ngo zhes pa'o// nu ma la lag pa 'jus te ston na/ nu ma'i 'o ma 'dra ba'i byang sems dkar po gang na gnas/ lag pas skra mtshams phye ste ston pa/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo na'o// lag pa sa la 'jog pa ston na/ sa gzhi la rten cing longs spyod pa bzhin du phyag rgya la rten cing longs spyod dam/ lag pa nam mkha' la yug pa ston na/ phyag rgya shes rab nam mkha' dang 'dra ba la longs spyod do// bzhin khro gnyer ston na/ 'dod chags kyi 'ching bar mi 'gyur ram/ gtsug phud grol ba ston na/ thabs shes pa mi 'ching zhing grol ba'i rgyur 'gyur/ dpral ba ston na/ rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi thabs la brten nas mas brtan gyi lhan skyes kyi sems mngon du byed par phyogs sam/ rgyab ston pa 'khor ba la rgyab phyogs pa'i phyir byas so// rkang mthil ston na/ rkang mthil thur du phyogs pa ltar/ byang chub kyi sems thur du mi lhung ngam/ byis pa sgo nga rtse ba ltar ston na/ byang chub kyi sems brtan pa je mtho je mtho gyur to// rnal 'byor ma gang*/ ngag gi e ma bu ni snying rje chen po zhes smra la/ 'phreng ba ston na/ 'o skol gnyis lhan cig tu 'du 'am/ brtul zhugs bzang po zhes brjod cing*// 'phreng ba de la gtad pa 'du'o zhes pa'o// brda don gsum gyi bshad pa mkha' 'gro'i gsang gtam zhes pa pad+ma dkar pos sbyin pa'i rdzas so/// / oṃ ye dhar+m+mā he tu pra bhā wa he tun+te ṣān+ta thā to h+ya wa da ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī mahā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/// /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
